NOTIFICATION
This is for information of all concerned that the Official Website of APPSC
(https://appsc.gov.in) will remain temporarily unavailable for 48 hours w.e.f.
lTth to 18th August 2026 due to scheduled website maintenance.
During this period, the website and all the online activities may not be
accessible. The normal online services of the website will be restored immediately
upon successful completion of the maintenance process.
Inconvenience caused is deeply regretted.
